# Child conversations and coordination

Subagents in the built-in engine are now saved child conversations. Enter a
child from Agents, send follow-up instructions, answer its questions, stop it
independently, or continue it later with its history intact. Profiles remain
reusable starting configurations, with a new Verify profile for shell-based
checks and a strict read-only Explore profile.

Parents can launch background children, inspect their state, send instructions,
and wait for reports. A host-owned coordinator serializes each child's work,
bounds parallel execution, preserves instruction receipts, and acknowledges
reports only after parent history is saved. Mutation-capable children coordinate
access to the shared workspace. Reloaded work is marked interrupted and requires
a new instruction; uncertain tool effects are never silently replayed.

The Agents tab now includes real conversations, activity, individual Stop,
scoped decisions, model and round controls, and explicit Report to parent.
OpenCode children also support direct follow-ups while their native delegation
is live. Native credentials, history, and permissions remain native.

Existing saved observations remain available as interrupted read-only history.
Automatic worktrees and independent continuation of settled native delegations
are not part of this release.

Persian writing now offers formal and informal registers while preserving the
detailed writing rules. Bundled skill upgrades also deliver the Persian checker
and preserve user-edited or deleted resources. Developer-access guidance covers
dependency mirrors and model acquisition, with measured local-model sizing.

Fresh installations enable Zarinpal's official public documentation MCP for
payment integration and error lookup. It needs no merchant credentials; existing
MCP configurations stay intact, with Zarinpal available in the curated catalog.

# Stability fixes

Windows workspace ownership checks keep the extension host responsive while
another window is writing. Checkpoints recover from interrupted initialization,
and extension shutdown waits for the browser, OpenCode, and external MCP servers.

MCP edits can be discarded inside the editor, Explorer attachments survive
startup, and each scoped settings page offers its own engine picker. The
built-in runtime handles more provider stream formats and preserves tool call
identities and thinking blocks across long conversations.
